title: Liver-related biomarkers mediate the potential effect of volatile organic compounds on an anti-aging hormone: a cross-sectional study
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1189-1202
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00270B, Paper

Shuaifei Ji, Yiming Bi, Bochen An, Jingcheng Zhou, Lixin Yu, Ding Zeng
Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) are a class of air pollutants that have adverse metabolic and endocrine effects. α-Klotho, an anti-aging hormone, is susceptible to environmental pollution.
